items.name: solid-principles
items.title: Solid Principles
items.description: Apply the SOLID principles as design diagnostics, detecting god classes, fragile hierarchies, fat interfaces, and hard-wired dependencies, and prescribing the smallest structural fix rather than imposing ceremony. Use when designing a new module or class, reviewing object-oriented code, or untangling a class that keeps changing for unrelated reasons.
items.author: Khaled Saeed
